articles.summary: Planet Green discloses NYSE American deficiency notice after reporting a $573,528 stockholders’ deficit and 5 years of losses; plan due Jan. 7, 2026 to regain compliance.
articles.title: Planet Green Holdings Corp. Receives NYSE Deficiency Notification Regarding Shareholders' Equity

articles.summary: Planet Green’s Shengsili unit unveils a new Black Gold black tea line rooted in 400-year heritage, after distributors praised its quality and aroma.
articles.title: Planet Green Holdings Corp. Unveiled New "Shengshengchuan Black Gold" Black Tea Series
